translations.tagline: Una pagina epica della guerra del Vietnam.

translations.overview: A pragmatic U.S. Marine observes the dehumanizing effects the U.S.-Vietnam War has on his fellow recruits from their brutal boot camp training to the bloody street fighting in Hue.
translations.tagline: In Vietnam, the wind doesn't blow. It sucks.
